\

A report completed as a "Mini Project" in [STAT 452 - Correlated Data](https://catalog.macalester.edu/preview_course_nopop.php?catoid=28&coid=145820) in the fall of 2025. This project analyzes electricity usage at Macalester’s Eco House using time series methods to identify long-term trends, seasonal patterns, and forecast future consumption. The results show a peak in usage around 2018 followed by a gradual decline, strong seasonal variation, and stable short-term dynamics captured well by an AR(2) model.

\

This report was created by [Katelyn McClure](https://katelynmcclure.github.io){target="_blank"} and [Lilabeth Sokolewicz](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lilabeth-sokolewicz-428490242/){target="_blank"} for Professor Brianna Heggeseth.
